summary: Tested Community Journal / Heritage Stories feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Created new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_stories_api.py covering root regression, public list/detail/cover, admin auth, CRUD, slug uniqueness, publish toggles, and soft-delete. 13/13 backend tests pass. Frontend flows validated via Playwright: public /stories page shows seeded 'diwali-in-the-old-sabha-courtyard' card with valid wa.me mini-share link, detail page renders story-title + Share on WhatsApp button, unknown slug shows data-testid='story-error', main nav has Journal link, admin login → 'Journal' shortcut (data-testid='admin-goto-stories') → /admin/stories manager lists seed story, empty submit shows required error, create draft works, Publish/Unpublish toggle updates status pill, cover upload surfaces 503 storage-not-configured with friendly message, and pasted image URL renders preview.
critical_code_review_comments: adminStories.js uniqueSlug loop limit is 50 — falls back to base-<timestamp> if exceeded; acceptable but silent.
Story.excerpt is regenerated only when body is updated; if body unchanged but title/subtitle updated, excerpt could get out-of-sync (minor).
Stories.jsx uses buildWhatsAppShareUrl containing origin + slug — verified encoded and correct.
seed_data_creation: Seed story 'diwali-in-the-old-sabha-courtyard' preserved. Test-created stories were deleted via API after testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/ (env var isn't set globally so must be exported). Frontend uses native window.confirm() for row delete — Playwright must register dialog handler BEFORE clicking the trash icon. Story editor title vs subtitle inputs — prefer exact placeholder selectors ('e.g. Diwali in the old Sabha courtyard' vs 'A short line under the title').
rca of the issue: No functional bugs found this iteration.
